reviews.t: Pigmented, easy to blend, beautiful results!
reviews.x: In love with this palette! The shimmers are surprising and I love the matte selection. Everything I’ve tried so far blends easily, is super flattering,  and I had no trouble blending the black shade to deepen the other mattes as well. I used ELF’s white putty eyeshadow primer. Highly recommend this palette! PS Anwen is amazing!

The swatches do not do this pallete justice at all!!! The mattes are very pigmented and the shimmers are so smooth and buttery. They pop to the high heavens! When I saw the packaging on the sight I thought it was a bit bland but in real life the color shifting on the entire palette is mesmerising. I have some higher end makeup that doesn't perform as well on my skin tone.  You can't go wrong with this pallete!

I was so excited to recieve this item. Sadly a couple of the shades came shattered. I'm buying a new palette and we'll see if that one comes in better condition. Beautiful palette, just wish it was packed and shipped better.

First of all I would've bought this even if I hated the color story &thought it was trash, just to support Anwen! If you're unaware of her, she's an affordable makeup reviewer on YouTube &she's an absolute doll! The woman is absolutely delightful &although long winded, very charming. She professes to not be any good at makeup (LIES) &one of her catch phrases is "I mean really guys!" hence the front of the sleeve. All of the shade names are names she picked out for people &places that are near &d

reviews.t: The stars I gave are all for the product & Anwen (none for packaging)
reviews.x: I was so excited 2 see Anwen got a colab! I love her so much! "I mean really" I purchased 2 palettes! Sadly both arrived broken. I put in for replacements. when the replacements arrive I will use the formula & update my review with my thoughts♡♡♡ #iLoveYouAnwen *!!EDITED 2 UPDATE!!* My replacements arrived! Packaging was still the same (NOT GOOD) But by the grace of the makeup gods both palettes arrived intact and unbroken!!! As far as the formula goes, I was pleased. The matte shadows aren't pe

reviews.t: Beautiful on the eye, love all the colors!
reviews.x: Beautiful on the eye, love all the colors!! I'm a fan of Anwen but even if I weren't, I would still be interested in this. A win all around!
Great palette! It's so beautiful and pigmented. I always love UCANBE palettes and this is no exception 😊 The packaging is also gorgeous. You won't regret purchasing!

The packaging is very inviting. Like to make a conscious decisions about what am I buying,so I was more than happy to see that this palette has a few positivities for me to buy it. It’s cruelty free, infused with natural ingredients for the longevity and using minerals for the best pigmentations. That was my yes for buying it, my skin is sensitive, specially around my eyes. No disappointment, the day I got, I tried out at least 5 different color combinations and my skin wasn’t burning or wasn’t

I am a big fan of Anwen's YouTube channel.  She has such a vibrant and quirky personality and this palette matches it.  Don't quite get why it was called Cellophane but I just think of it as the "I Mean Really!" palette.  I found all the shades to be pigmented.  There are a lot of different textures/finishes to the shades.  Some almost have a putty like feel like "Okay So" and "Redondo" and those were easier to apply with fingers or a silicone applicator.  The super shimmery "Yes B Yes" is very

One of my favorite Youtubers is Anwen so when she got this collab with this Cellophane palette, I was so excited for her! I got this palette and I've had a few days to try it out and I love it! Each row is like it's own mini palette with its own color story, but together, they make some great looks. I can safely say that many of these shades are completely unique to my collection. I also love the color changing packaging! These swatches don't give justice to how beautiful they look on the eyes.

I have watched Anwen On YouTube for several years and when I seen she was doing a collab with UCANBE I was very skeptical of buying the palette but I wanted to support her as a creator. I do not regret it at all. It is a beautiful eyeshadow palette. There is a wide range of colors and textures in this palette. It is outstanding for the price and performs better than some I have paid way more for..

The shimmers in this palette are fantastic. Very foiled and smooth. Almost like cream. The mattes are ok not the most pigmented but can be built up. They blend well too. The only thing I'm not crazy about is theres only 1 deeper shade (black) other than that its mostly all midtones. Cant really get much of a gradient with this palette alone. I just pull other palettes for deeper shades.

I wanted to love this so much because i love Anwen and the color story is *chefs kiss* but the color payoff on a brush is meh at best. Finger payoff is bomb, but getting that to translate on an eyelid takes work! She has potential for the price, i just wish it were a homerun 😫😥 not a failure! She just takes work.

As soon as I saw this palette, I knew I had to have it. This was everything I thought it was and MORE. Shades are buttery soft and blend like a dream. Add this to my collection. Keep this around so when I run out, I’ll be back for another.
I had a very easy time working with this palette and the colors were really beautiful.  I will definitely be reaching for this again!
The prettiest.. color shades! Application smooth as silk. Love it. Thanks will buy again... other colors
This palette is beautiful amazing quilty awesome colors very unique.
the shadows are beautiful but unfortunately my palette came broken

I have to say I was so surprised by the pigmentation this pallete had. Now I won’t lie the more pastel shades did disappoint me, but I had low hopes for those anyway, they’re hard to get right. One other complaint I had, like a few other reviews stated I ended up with a broken eyeshadow. The copper shade in the bottom left was the only one that came broken. I love this eyeshadow pallett. It comes with a nice variety of colors. I like how some are matte and some are shimmery. It was packaged nicely and comes with a mirror so it's great to take it on the go. It blends nicely and lasts all day. I use the "Icy Queen" to put on top of the other colors and it adds the perfect amount of shimmer and looks so pretty. The colors are highly pigmented and overall great quality for the price.

Where to even start? This palette has it all. The value is amazing for what you get, the palette it's self is simply stunning from the packaging to the actual shadows. The formula is amazing. It's easy to blend, it's buttery, and it's super pigmented. There's nothing bad to say about it. But I've come to love the UCANBE palettes. They're formula's are amazing and their prices are so affordable.

I absolutely love this palette. So many different shades and it really sparks my creativity just looking at it. The formula is creamy, and the colors are super pigmented. I’m a beginner when it comes to applying eyeshadow, but this palette is so easy to use. No patchiness, no fallout and it blends really well!

The Yes B shade was broken but Anwen said they’re working on reformulating. I just pressed it back in, not a huge deal. All the shades are sooo beautiful. They are so pigmented and blend wonderfully. I purchased it to support Anwen but the palette itself is just wonderful.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the palette's pigmentation and easy blending, calling the shades beautiful and buttery.
Many reviewers mention buying the palette to support YouTuber Anwen and are happy with the collaboration.
Several reviewers report the palette arriving broken or shattered, and some note poor packaging/shipping.
Some reviewers find the mattes less pigmented or requiring effort to build up, especially with a brush.
Reviewers praise the shimmers as smooth, foiled, and buttery.
